title: Spiced Potato Gratin
description: A creamy and earthy twist on the classic gratin, inspired by Indian flavors. Perfect for a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.notes: or substitute with coconut cream for a dairy-free option

instructions: Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, onion, and garlic.
In a separate bowl, combine the heavy cream, cheddar cheese, garam masala, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the cream mixture over the potato mixture and toss to coat.
Transfer the potato mixture to the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
